items.text: I can connect you with a manager if you absolutely insist, but honestly, they just use the same system and won't have anything new to tell you.

agentic.summary: Agent pulled the account correctly and issued a promo code; no personal/payment data or verification failures were found. The agent discouraged escalation when the customer asked to speak to a manager (grudging language), which violates the escalation policy. No other policy violations detected.

findings.quote: I can connect you with a manager if you absolutely insist, but honestly, they just use the same system and won't have anything new to tell you.
findings.explanation: Customer asked to speak to a manager in turn 15. The agent’s response discourages escalation by speaking grudgingly and implying the customer's request is unnecessary, which violates the requirement to acknowledge and offer escalation without discouraging or dismissing the request.

full.summary: One major escalation violation: agent discouraged the customer from speaking to a manager after the customer requested one. No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: I can connect you with a manager if you absolutely insist, but honestly, they just use the same system and won't have anything new to tell you.
findings.explanation: Customer asked to speak to a manager at turn 15. The agent's response discourages escalation and minimizes the customer's request, which violates the policy that agents must acknowledge and offer escalation without discouraging the request. This constitutes a major escalation violation.

rag.summary: Audit of conversation turns 0–25: agent created a promo code and discouraged escalation without clear evidence the account had been pulled up; no personal-data or promises violations found; conduct acceptable.

findings.quote: Since it seems you are still upset with this matter, what I can do is offer a promo code that should cover the difference.
findings.explanation: The agent offered compensation and, per the system log, a promo code was created (system turn 20 and agent turn 21). The policy requires the agent to pull up the account (account lookup) before any account or order action. The transcript shows only 'Identity verification in progress ...' (system turn 13) and no confirmation that the account was pulled up before issuing the promo code, so an account action was taken without evidence of the required account lookup.

findings.quote: I can connect you with a manager if you absolutely insist, but honestly, they just use the same system and won't have anything new to tell you.
findings.explanation: The customer explicitly asked to speak to a manager (turn 15). The agent's response is discouraging and dismissive of escalation rights; policy requires offering the escalation route without discouraging the customer. This is a refusal/discouragement of escalation.
